result_policy: Every merged case is NOT_RUN; covered_by names an existing fail-first witness that checks the invariant through the real interface, which is a coverage claim, not a pass.

execution_semantics.once: one driver run with one independent oracle satisfies every alias
execution_semantics.distinct: one invariant and oracle, but the merged case needs several executions (both orderings plus a no-race control, per-table store copies, paired worlds, per-variant fixtures or per-mutant runs)

cases.semantic_invariant: Opening a genuinely older-schema store migrates it additively to the current schema only after an exact pre-migration backup, preserving domain rows and their meaning.
cases.independent_oracle: Raw SQL on the pre-migrate backup file equals the pre-upgrade rows and schema_version; the reopened store reports max(_MIGRATIONS) and every seeded feature row reads back unchanged.
cases.note: Existing controls seed only a jobs row (plus one legacy candidate); per-feature domain rows at each version are not yet asserted.

cases.semantic_invariant: A failed pre-migration backup leaves the original old-schema store byte-unchanged and refuses to open a partially migrated live store.
cases.independent_oracle: File hash of the original DB before and after the refused open is identical and raw schema_version keeps the old value; the open raises an explicit failure.

cases.semantic_invariant: Every tracked entrypoint that can open a live-default store either applies the backup discipline before migrating or never migrates, and the offline validator never opens the database.
cases.independent_oracle: Per-entrypoint recorder of backup-hook calls and schema_version before/after on a synthetic old store under a synthetic user-path root; file-open recorder shows the validator never touches the DB.

cases.semantic_invariant: A migration interrupted after DDL but before commit reopens with no rows lost and no table family accepted as clean merely from partial DDL.
cases.independent_oracle: A disposable child killed at a named DDL barrier; raw row counts and sqlite_master of the reopened copy compared with the backup; no schema_repaired event for a partial family.

cases.semantic_invariant: A current store missing a core relation (jobs or artifacts) refuses or quarantines loudly instead of recreating an empty replacement that hides data loss.
cases.independent_oracle: Drop one core table in a closed copy and reopen: refusal naming corruption plus a pre-repair backup whose raw row counts equal the original.

cases.semantic_invariant: A populated note root missing note_revisions or attachments is never presented as a clean empty note state.
cases.independent_oracle: Drop one note relation in a closed copy and reopen: raw SQL still shows the notes rows, and the open or NoteStore.open_note reports corruption with a preserved backup.

cases.semantic_invariant: Losing any later relational family (training_memberships, profile_evidence, learning_vocabulary_deltas, usage_facts and every other tracked family) from a current-schema store is never repaired into a silently intact empty family.
cases.independent_oracle: Per family, a closed-copy store with exactly that table dropped and reopened with a backup dir: either refusal naming corruption with an untouched pre-repair backup, or the semantic consequence the table carried (exposure, dead support, user edit, deleted usage) still holds by raw SQL.
cases.note: Umbrella finding case for LF-CROSS-F001 (training_memberships, profile_evidence, learning_vocabulary_deltas, usage_facts); deliberately NOT collapsed into Audit B's profile_evidence-only witness, which is its own sub-case below. The vocabulary family (entries, aliases, history, meta) is governed by M05-AUDIT-18: the Store repairs it and VocabularyStore.integrity_report plus app startup detect the tear, so its witnesses are the two torn-dictionary controls.

cases.semantic_invariant: After training_memberships is lost from a current store, a family once exposed for tuning never returns to the blind frozen_test holdout as unexposed.
cases.independent_oracle: The witness records the exposed family id before the drop; after reopen and assign, raw SQL on training_memberships shows no (frozen_test, exposed=0) row for it, or the open refuses with a pre-repair backup.
cases.note: Sub-witness A of MERGED-X01.

cases.semantic_invariant: After profile_evidence is lost, deleting every supporting source never leaves the private derived profile text current.
cases.independent_oracle: A witness-chosen private canary phrase is absent from ProfileService.current() and from raw profile_snapshots measured_json/cards_json after delete_everywhere of every source, or the open refuses with a backup.
cases.note: Sub-witness B of MERGED-X01; this is Audit B's CROSS-AUDIT-05 scope only.

cases.semantic_invariant: After learning_vocabulary_deltas is lost, Undo Approval never disables or rewrites an entry the user edited after approval.
cases.independent_oracle: Raw (canonical, enabled) of the user-edited entry still equals the user's edit with enabled=1 after undo on the reopened copy, or the open refuses with a backup.
cases.note: Sub-witness C of MERGED-X01.

cases.semantic_invariant: After usage_facts or a usage/config family is lost, deleted usage never persists in a published aggregate and user registries never silently read as empty or restart their revision.
cases.independent_oracle: Raw daily_aggregates after delete_usage_for_job carries no count including the deleted job; style_rules/snippets/profiles_meta keep rows and revisions; or the open refuses with a backup.
cases.note: Sub-witness D of MERGED-X01.

cases.semantic_invariant: Losing any M14 relation (approval deltas, exposure memberships, operation receipts) cannot create a duplicate effect on retry, erase undo authority or reset exposure.
cases.independent_oracle: Per dropped relation: a same-operation retry yields one effect by raw row count, undo keeps the user edit, the exposed family never turns blind; or the open refuses with a backup.
cases.note: Operation-receipt loss has no existing witness.

cases.semantic_invariant: Re-importing a legacy log with an appended completed tail neither duplicates the already-imported prefix nor loses the tail, and unknown historical dates stay unknown.
cases.independent_oracle: Independent byte-prefix hash and count of completed entries in the synthetic log compared with the imported raw rows; undated rows keep a NULL time.

cases.semantic_invariant: A write refused before store admission has no side effect, while an admitted write that times out may still commit and must be reported unknown until settled.
cases.independent_oracle: Admission counter plus raw committed rows: the closed-admission call leaves zero rows; the admitted timed-out call's row appears after release and its caller outcome was unknown, not failed.

cases.semantic_invariant: An operation id already completed for target A is refused when reused for target B, never treated as B's success.
cases.independent_oracle: Raw receipt row keyed by operation id and target plus both targets' rows: B unchanged and OperationReused raised.

cases.semantic_invariant: A corrupt managed locator containing traversal, absolute or final-symlink names is refused by every domain read, export and purge and never touches a file outside the managed root.
cases.independent_oracle: An outside sentinel file's hash and mtime are unchanged after read/export/purge attempts; explicit managed-name refusal reason; an in-root control succeeds.

cases.semantic_invariant: Swapping an in-root ancestor for a symlink after listing cannot make a downstream read escape the managed root.
cases.independent_oracle: The outside canary is never read (content hash and access recorder) after the swap; the open refuses via descriptor-relative no-follow resolution.

cases.semantic_invariant: A managed locator naming a FIFO, directory or device-like node is refused by regular-file admission without blocking or reading.
cases.independent_oracle: A bounded probe completes within its deadline, the FIFO writer side never unblocks, and a refusal reason is recorded.

cases.semantic_invariant: A downstream consumer never broadens the configured explicit root or re-resolves an unrestricted path from a discovered child.
cases.independent_oracle: Every path in the frozen manifest lies inside the configured root; an outside child canary is never read.

cases.semantic_invariant: A failed attempt followed by a successful retry of the same capture leaves exactly one usage dictation fact carrying the current terminal outcome and the original capture instant.
cases.independent_oracle: Raw COUNT(*) FROM usage_facts WHERE job_id=J equals 1, its outcome is attempt 2's and its activity time equals the witness-recorded original capture instant; the daily aggregate is recomputed independently.
cases.note: x07 asserts one usage fact per retried job but not the outcome replacement or original instant.

cases.semantic_invariant: Retries of one capture, even with different ASR text, never add logical dictations, words or interpretation-floor support to Your Voice.
cases.independent_oracle: Five synthetic captures each retried with distinct scripted text: measured eligible_examples<=5 and eligible_words<=5x the per-capture words, interpretive_available false; raw usage_facts count per job equals 1; ten independent captures do reach the floor.

cases.semantic_invariant: Two distinct captures with identical text count as two jobs in usage, and any profile text de-duplication is disclosed without merging capture identities.
cases.independent_oracle: Raw usage_facts has two job ids; the snapshot's exclusion reasons name the repetition and profile_evidence keeps both source ids distinct.

cases.semantic_invariant: Autosaving and restoring a note that received dictation J creates no new capture, job or dictation count.
cases.independent_oracle: Raw counts of jobs and usage_facts are equal before and after autosave and restore while note_revisions increase.

cases.semantic_invariant: After a collection-on attempt leaves a partial manifest and a collection-off retry succeeds with different text, History resolves the retry's final and no action uses the old manifest.
cases.independent_oracle: The scripted worker records what cleanup received for attempt 2; job_detail lineage_attempt equals 2, final_text equals that received text upper-cased, attempt-1 text is absent from the lineage, and the saved note text by raw SQL equals it.

cases.semantic_invariant: A retry after midnight or after a new boot keeps the original capture instant, sample rate and known gaps; unknown originals stay unknown and retry latency is labeled separately.
cases.independent_oracle: Independently prepared audio metadata (rate, frames, capture instant) compared with the provenance sidecar, store rows and the usage-fact day after a retry under a controlled clock.

cases.semantic_invariant: A retry honors the original capture's consent snapshot and lineage, obeys a later revocation, never mints a new family to bypass it, and increments the attempt once.
cases.independent_oracle: Raw consent_revision_id and family_id of the original vs retry example rows; no new example after revocation; jobs.attempt incremented exactly once.

cases.semantic_invariant: Retrying an old job never consumes a queued one-shot Next Mode override; the next new capture receives it.
cases.independent_oracle: Frozen policy rows of the retry and of the next new job: the retry has no override, the new capture has the Raw override.

cases.semantic_invariant: Two simultaneous Retry commands on one recoverable job admit exactly one owned retry with no duplicate logical effect or fabricated confirmation.
cases.independent_oracle: A latch at claim admission; raw attempt counter increments once, one usage fact, one insertion submission counted at the fake backend.

cases.semantic_invariant: Delivering the same successful terminal callback twice yields one terminal outcome, one dictation fact and one insertion submission.
cases.independent_oracle: Raw job/attempt rows and usage_facts counts before and after; insertion submissions counted at the fake host.

cases.semantic_invariant: A held attempt-1 completion released after attempt 2 is active changes no current text, state, artifact manifest, usage row or insertion authority.
cases.independent_oracle: The witness records attempt-2 id and stage digests before release; after release raw artifacts, usage rows and insertion submissions are unchanged.

cases.semantic_invariant: A response from a replaced worker generation is discarded even when its text or task id resembles current work.
cases.independent_oracle: A barrier holds the generation-1 response while generation 2 starts; after release: no publication, no insertion submission and an explicit stale-discard event.

cases.semantic_invariant: A retry result released after delete-everywhere recreates no governed content, learning or profile eligibility.
cases.independent_oracle: Raw SQL over artifacts, examples, candidates and profile_evidence for the deleted job id is empty after release and the tombstone row is present.

cases.semantic_invariant: Worker death at the ASR boundary leaves a recoverable job holding the original audio and never publishes a fabricated transcript.
cases.independent_oracle: Audio digest and sample count equal the witness-recorded capture; job state failed_recoverable with a reason; no raw_transcript artifact and no insertion submission.

cases.semantic_invariant: A posted but unobservable insertion stays posted_unverified across History, usage and review eligibility and never mints a confirmation or gold/correctness label.
cases.independent_oracle: The host adapter declares no readback capability; raw terminal outcome and usage-fact outcome are posted_unverified; no annotation or label rows are created.

cases.semantic_invariant: A completed text whose target revalidation refuses stays saved_not_inserted with recoverable text, distinct from a failed pipeline that has no final_words.
cases.independent_oracle: Raw outcomes and final_words of the saved job vs a separate ASR-failed job; no target write observed at the fake host.

cases.semantic_invariant: A cancellation after generation begins is terminal: a late worker result causes no insertion and cannot reopen the job.
cases.independent_oracle: Insertion submissions at the fake host stay 0; raw job state is cancelled with one terminal outcome.

cases.semantic_invariant: A cancel that lands before the irreversible post prevents any external insertion and is never overwritten by a stale callback.
cases.independent_oracle: A latch at the insertion admission/backend boundary; backend post calls counted equal 0; job state stays cancelled after the queue drains.

cases.semantic_invariant: A cancel after the paste was irreversibly posted leaves an honest outcome for the posted effect, with no never-inserted claim and no resend.
cases.independent_oracle: The fake keyboard records exactly one post; the final outcome row names it; resend count 0.

cases.semantic_invariant: Every coordinator caller distinguishes accepted, queued, reconciled-no-transaction and settled insertion outcomes and never infers success from a truthy return.
cases.independent_oracle: Per caller: the value returned by the real service vs the outcome the caller reports; the no-transaction case records no repaste fact.

cases.semantic_invariant: A target whose PID remains but whose bundle identity changed refuses insertion and context continuation; PID alone grants nothing.
cases.independent_oracle: A synthetic host with same PID and different bundle; write calls at the host equal 0; refusal reason names the identity mismatch.

cases.semantic_invariant: A strict transform accept never replaces text in a look-alike window or field that merely shares the captured title or text.
cases.independent_oracle: Two synthetic owned windows with equal titles; after switching, the uncaptured field's content hash is unchanged and the accept refuses.

cases.semantic_invariant: Moving the selection to another occurrence of identical text requires original region proof; text equality never retargets a replacement.
cases.independent_oracle: A field with two identical occurrences; after accept the second occurrence's byte range is unchanged and the result is a refusal.

cases.semantic_invariant: Usage and History metadata about a target never grant insertion authority after the target lease is revoked.
cases.independent_oracle: Fake host write count 0 for a repaste after lease revocation; refusal reason recorded; the usage app label is unchanged.

cases.semantic_invariant: A target capture lacking required PID/element ownership cannot grant strict transform replacement, and strict accept never downgrades to plain dictation insertion.
cases.independent_oracle: A synthetic capture without ownership; host write calls recorded for both paths: the strict path refuses, the dictation path follows its own proof rule.

cases.semantic_invariant: A retry while another app is focused keeps the original capture app in usage metadata and enforces current insertion safety independently.
cases.independent_oracle: Raw usage_facts app_bundle equals capture app A; host write calls into B equal 0.

cases.semantic_invariant: In Raw mode the delivered final is the original ASR bytes, with no normalization or cleanup expansion and no claim that a cleanup model ran.
cases.independent_oracle: The scripted worker records no clean() call; the final artifact bytes equal the scripted ASR text; stage roles show the raw route; no cleanup record reaches model_task_complete.

cases.semantic_invariant: App bundle ids differing only by case or surrounding space resolve to one canonical scope across vocabulary, style and approval.
cases.independent_oracle: Independently computed canonical form; raw scope values and rule-match results identical across variants; exactly one scoped change row.

cases.semantic_invariant: Only documented canonical site-origin equivalents match; port and www differences never alias.
cases.independent_oracle: A table of origin variants with independently computed expected match/no-match vs rule-hit ids per variant.

cases.semantic_invariant: Workspace and profile scopes are exact opaque identities after documented trimming, never case-folded or inferred from the filesystem, across matching, approval and undo.
cases.independent_oracle: Names differing by case or Unicode spelling do not match (empty rule hits), whitespace-only variants do, and undo touches only the exact scope row.
cases.note: LF-CROSS-C017 also exercises site canonicalization; that half overlaps the site-origin case above.

cases.semantic_invariant: Missing destination identity never broadens a scoped rule into global effect; only explicit global rules apply.
cases.independent_oracle: The same phrase normalized with and without identity: scoped rule hit ids absent without identity, the global rule present in both.

cases.semantic_invariant: When field context cannot be read, the finalized snapshot uses only permitted known facts and invents no site, workspace or selection authority.
cases.independent_oracle: Snapshot JSON carries omission reasons and null site/workspace/selection scope inputs.

cases.semantic_invariant: Secure or denied fields are classified and refused before any content read, so no field text, hint words or selection escape.
cases.independent_oracle: Canaries planted in the synthetic secure field are searched in every snapshot, event, artifact and payload family with zero hits; provider read calls are recorded as not made.

cases.semantic_invariant: A late context delta stays attached to its own capture handle and parent revision and never replaces another capture's scope.
cases.independent_oracle: Handle ids, parent links and scope fingerprints of both captures compared after releasing capture 1's delayed provider.

cases.semantic_invariant: A job with no usable workspace freezes no skill or file-tag authority cached from a prior workspace.
cases.independent_oracle: The frozen job-2 skill set in its raw policy JSON is empty or reason-coded; job-1 skills are absent.

cases.semantic_invariant: A provider that misses the pre-decode cutoff but finishes before take_downstream produces a new downstream revision naming its parent while the pre-decode snapshot stays immutable.
cases.independent_oracle: Both snapshots' JSON and hashes: the pre-decode one unchanged, the downstream revision's parent id equal to it, and consumers read the declared one.

cases.semantic_invariant: When scope widening misses the release budget, the whole captured tuple (profile, number policy, skill registry, vocabulary) is kept together; no finalized profile runs over old scoped vocabulary.
cases.independent_oracle: The frozen tuple's revision ids all come from the same capture moment; no mixed tuple is observed.

cases.semantic_invariant: Vocabulary, style, snippet and transform definitions mutated after freeze do not affect the current job, while the next admitted job sees them.
cases.independent_oracle: Frozen revision ids per definition family for job 1 vs job 2 by raw policy rows; job-1 outputs match the pre-mutation expected text.

cases.semantic_invariant: Replacing an approved private file or listing after freeze never causes an unchecked new read; the consumer uses the frozen content or refuses.
cases.independent_oracle: A file-open recorder on the synthetic root shows no new read after freeze; prompt content equals the frozen manifest content.

cases.semantic_invariant: A one-job mode override is consumed only by the intended capture; the following capture inherits configured policy.
cases.independent_oracle: Frozen profile mode for both job ids by raw SQL.

cases.semantic_invariant: A transform-backed mode without auto-apply opt-in never silently applies the transform and records the fallback mode and reason.
cases.independent_oracle: Transform executions at the scripted worker are 0 (or the result is not applied); the final artifact role is cleanup; the fallback reason is recorded.

cases.semantic_invariant: A lower-scope pinned term never bypasses the documented higher-scope precedence and masking policy.
cases.independent_oracle: Independently computed winning scope; the frozen projection contains only the winner.

cases.semantic_invariant: Snippet-expanded multiline technical text keeps exact protected bytes through normalization and cleanup or a later stage refuses; uncertified terminal targets stay copy-only.
cases.independent_oracle: Witness-recorded expansion bytes vs the final protected regions; cleanup validator findings for any mutation; insertion method for the uncertified terminal target.

cases.semantic_invariant: Quoted or literal spoken commands stay literal text; only a separately authorized structure command becomes syntax.
cases.independent_oracle: A hand-computed expected output for the synthetic utterance vs the normalized ledger's edit kinds and final text.

cases.semantic_invariant: Negative numbers, decimal scale, comma lists and version prose keep sign, value and clause ownership into the cleanup validator; ambiguity is an explicit refusal.
cases.independent_oracle: Hand-computed expected values per span vs the normalized ledger and validator findings.

cases.semantic_invariant: Protected ranges map to the correct occurrence through normalization and chunked cleanup; unmappable evidence causes a lossless refusal or fallback.
cases.independent_oracle: The protected identifier's occurrence index recorded independently vs the final output region at that index.

cases.semantic_invariant: A snippet needing unavailable context never fabricates a value or inserts incomplete template syntax as a successful expansion.
cases.independent_oracle: The expansion result carries the declared fallback/refusal reason and the output contains no raw placeholder token.

cases.semantic_invariant: A phrase overlapping a snippet trigger and a dictionary alias receives the documented precedence exactly once, without double expansion or an erased protected boundary.
cases.independent_oracle: The edit ledger vs an independently written conflict-fixture ledger.

cases.semantic_invariant: Real-model Clean preserves version literals, paths and negated instructions, or falls back with a truthful path.
cases.independent_oracle: Literal and requirement assertions independent of the validator's own output on a model-capable run.

cases.semantic_invariant: Interleaved evidence callbacks of two jobs with identical text keep every artifact and revision attached to its producing job.
cases.independent_oracle: Both job/attempt ids traced through raw artifacts and envelopes; equal hashes never share ownership.

cases.semantic_invariant: A cleanup-only worker fault leaves the raw source traceable and records a reason-coded fallback, never a successful model output.
cases.independent_oracle: Stage artifacts and the recorded path compared with the injected stage failure.

cases.semantic_invariant: Enabling collection after a capture began never retroactively authorizes a training payload for that capture.
cases.independent_oracle: Raw consent_revision_id on the job and example rows; no example exists for that capture.

cases.semantic_invariant: Pausing collection before the next capture yields no new training example for it while the dictation still completes.
cases.independent_oracle: Examples counted by capture id in raw SQL; the second job's delivered text observed at the fake host.

cases.semantic_invariant: With collection disabled, raw/clean/transform, History and usage still work while no training evidence or supervised export eligibility is invented.
cases.independent_oracle: Raw training_examples count 0 for the job, a usage fact present, and an export build containing no record for it.

cases.semantic_invariant: When normalization changed the cleanup input but its retention failed, the record is never a model_task_complete task binding text the model did not receive.
cases.independent_oracle: The scripted worker records the exact text cleanup received; envelope missing_reasons.normalization equals retention_write_failed; if eligible, the qualification input_text equals the received text.

cases.semantic_invariant: Normalization that changed no bytes keeps raw-as-input valid for a complete cleanup task, with no overbroad new refusal.
cases.independent_oracle: Input equality between the received text and raw; qualification eligible with tier model_task_complete.
cases.note: Negative control for MERGED-X05.

cases.semantic_invariant: A nonempty normalization pointer with invalid role, hash or liveness is refused by the existing bad-reference guard, never accepted via raw fallback.
cases.independent_oracle: A synthetic envelope carrying the bad pointer; the qualification is not eligible and names the bad-reference reason.
cases.note: Positive control for the narrower absent-pointer finding.

cases.semantic_invariant: Optional evidence-storage failure never drops the dictation; missing evidence is reported, never manufactured.
cases.independent_oracle: Delivered text at the fake host vs the persistence outcome; missing_reasons present; no fabricated artifact rows.

cases.semantic_invariant: Interleaved updates of one transform never make one revision number name two different definitions; the live row equals the preserved revision it names.
cases.independent_oracle: Raw transforms row (name, prompt, auto_apply, enabled, revision) vs transform_revisions.definition_json at that revision, after a latch holds updater A just before its mutation while B commits.

cases.semantic_invariant: After the disjoint-update race, a transform_supervised export of a candidate accepted at the live revision carries the definition that actually executed.
cases.independent_oracle: Independent comparison of live, frozen, preserved and exported definition fields and hash in the exported JSONL record.
cases.note: x03 asserts live equals preserved but does not build an export.

cases.semantic_invariant: A transform form rendered before a newer opt-out or instruction edit never reverses it when only an unrelated field is edited; the stale edit merges only the changed field or refuses.
cases.independent_oracle: Raw transforms row auto_apply and prompt after a name-only Update from the stale form; on refusal the unsaved edit survives in the form.

cases.semantic_invariant: An admitted Transform Add that times out is reported unknown, not not-saved, and repeating the same logical Add yields exactly one transform.
cases.independent_oracle: Writer hold plus caller timeout; the status text lacks 'not saved'; raw SELECT of transforms by name returns exactly one row after the repeat.

cases.semantic_invariant: Every auto-apply entry point runs the mode gate: a candidate dropping a required operator is never inserted as the accepted final and records no approval.
cases.independent_oracle: A scripted transform candidate missing the operator; the final artifact equals the Clean text; no preference or approval row exists.

cases.semantic_invariant: The note and chained transform path uses the same mode gate plus immutable note revision/region admission; revising or deleting the source note refuses the stale candidate.
cases.independent_oracle: Raw note_revisions unchanged after accepting against a changed or deleted revision; the refusal reason is recorded.

cases.semantic_invariant: A chained result used as a new source is a different task, while a Retry Original with identical frozen inputs keeps task identity; only true same-task candidates pair.
cases.independent_oracle: Frozen task components compared independently; the pair list contains only candidates sharing a task_key.

cases.semantic_invariant: Two transforms with different definition identities remain distinct tasks even when their outputs are identical.
cases.independent_oracle: Task components (definition id and revision) compared, not only a final hash; no pair offered across them.

cases.semantic_invariant: Prompt Engineer, Polish, Concise and Custom modes each enforce their own validator constraints and are never labeled universally equivalent.
cases.independent_oracle: Controlled proposals per mode with hand-computed accept/refuse expectations; validator revision recorded per mode.

cases.semantic_invariant: A proposal changing one character of an M11-protected path, URL or identifier is never silently applied.
cases.independent_oracle: Protected literal bytes in the final output equal the input; the gate result is not-applied.

cases.semantic_invariant: An auto-applied transform never synthesizes a user accept or preference, and the auto path stays distinct in transform-supervised readiness.
cases.independent_oracle: Raw preference_observations and accept rows for the job are absent; the readiness reason names the auto path.

cases.semantic_invariant: A held transform completion for source A released after the panel moved to source B cannot replace B's display, destination or acceptance authority.
cases.independent_oracle: Panel binding token before and after release; the accept target id; host write calls carrying A's output equal 0.

cases.semantic_invariant: A retained transform source or candidate whose digest or task input mismatches is refused and never given fabricated offline authority.
cases.independent_oracle: Corrupt one byte or swap in a source from another task; the qualification refusal reason; exported rows exclude it.

cases.semantic_invariant: Recovery Copy Last Raw never replaces a pasteboard payload owned by a pending M08 insertion.
cases.independent_oracle: Private pasteboard changeCount and string before and after copyLastRaw_ while clipboard_payload_pending is true are unchanged.

cases.independent_oracle: Pasteboard changeCount and string observed at the same points as the Recovery case; exactly one write after release.
cases.note: Control for MERGED-X02 (the existing guarded caller).

cases.semantic_invariant: LocalFlow never restores an obsolete prior clipboard over a newer external clipboard owner.
cases.independent_oracle: An external canary written to the private pasteboard after the post is still present after reconcile; changeCount advanced only by the canary write.

cases.semantic_invariant: An admitted Save Transform to Scratchpad that times out keeps its pending note identity, and repeating the same Save yields one note.
cases.independent_oracle: Writer hold plus caller timeout; raw SQL of notes joined to the current revision holding the canary text returns exactly one row after the repeat.

cases.semantic_invariant: A History Move whose source deletion was admitted but timed out is reported unknown, not failed, and a retry settles to one note and moved.
cases.independent_oracle: Raw job_deletions row after release; the first outcome is not move_failed_note_copied; one note row; the second outcome is moved with the same note_id.

cases.semantic_invariant: A note arrival is reported delivered only after its revision commits; a held commit never yields an early success, and a retry never duplicates the revision or effect.
cases.independent_oracle: Raw note_revisions and arrival receipt state before and after release; the outcome observed before commit is pending; the revision count grows by exactly one.

cases.semantic_invariant: An autosave pending while a dictation arrival commits never overwrites the typed tail or duplicates the arrival, in either release order.
cases.independent_oracle: Final note bytes equal the independently merged expected text in both release orders.

cases.semantic_invariant: A note-bound dictation's durable receipt is labeled note delivery and never presented as an external AX readback confirmation.
cases.independent_oracle: Raw usage_facts insertion outcome/method for the job; zero AX or pasteboard calls at the fake host.

cases.semantic_invariant: An owned external insertion writes no note revision and records exactly one external dictation fact.
cases.independent_oracle: Raw note_revisions count unchanged; one usage fact with an external outcome.

cases.semantic_invariant: A note-bound dictation commits once with a receipt, posts no external paste and leaves the external clipboard sentinel unchanged.
cases.independent_oracle: Fake host insert calls 0; pasteboard sentinel unchanged; one note revision; one usage fact.

cases.semantic_invariant: A note deleted or switched after capture never receives or retargets the dictation, and the text stays honestly recoverable.

cases.semantic_invariant: One dictated insertion followed by typed autosaves yields one dictation, and typed-only changes never become acoustic corrections.
cases.independent_oracle: Raw usage_facts count 1; learning_candidates from typed spans 0.

cases.semantic_invariant: Quitting with an admitted but unacknowledged note arrival drains it or preserves recovery authority and never claims saved merely on enqueue.
cases.independent_oracle: Arrival receipt id, eventual revision row and shutdown state tracked separately.

cases.semantic_invariant: A whole-note transform accepted after a typed suffix edit refuses rather than dropping the footer.
cases.independent_oracle: Full captured vs current note text; no new revision row.

cases.semantic_invariant: A History action stays bound to the rendered job and revision it was drawn with, or refuses, after the backing list reorders; row index never grants authority.
cases.independent_oracle: The rendered id recorded at the barrier vs the service argument the action receives and the effect on raw rows: J1 or refusal, never J2.

cases.semantic_invariant: A Teach dialog bound to one final refuses stale_final when a retry commits a different final before submit; it never corrects writer-current unseen output.
cases.independent_oracle: Submitted artifact id/hash vs the current final; learning_candidates count unchanged; refusal reason stale_final.

cases.independent_oracle: Zero learning_candidates rows minted; an explicit refusal reason is visible.
